title: Consistent Titlebar and Notification OSD Header look and behavior
line: Notification close, minimize and configure buttons now sit on the same side as the window titlebar buttons, so with a Mac-style layout they move to the left.
explanation: Notification headers look like a small titlebar, but their close, minimize and configure buttons were always on the right, even when the window decoration puts the close button on the left (Mac-style layout). Users switching the titlebar layout got close buttons on opposite sides in windows and in notifications. The applet now reads KWin's button layout (kwinrc, org.kde.kdecoration2, live via KConfigWatcher) and, when the close button is on the left, places the header buttons on the left in titlebar order (close outermost) in popups, history entries, group headers and grouped entries; the "n min ago" label moved into its own AgeLabel component so it stays at the far end.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: put header buttons on the titlebar button side

Notification headers always kept their close button on the right, even
when window titlebars have it on the left. The header buttons now follow
the window decoration's button layout, mirroring their side and order.

BUG: 431165

media.caption: Mac-style titlebar (close on the left), but notification popups keep their close and configure buttons on the right
Same layout: the popup close button is on the left, like the titlebar, in the same order
Notification history: every close button on the right
Notification history: header and grouped-entry buttons on the left, age label at the right end
